facts.anchor: Man Mo temple sat halfway up the Mid-Levels on Hollywood Road, looking down over the harbour to the north.
facts.fact: 文武庙位于好莱坞道半山，向北俯瞰海港；它是殖民地里最华丽的华式建筑，靠富商捐款建成，白墙配绿琉璃瓦，内里才是精华。

facts.anchor: Leung was in charge of the build but could only stretch in so many directions at one time.
facts.fact: 工程由 Leung 负责，但他一人分身乏术，会堂至今只是梁柱骨架、尚未完工，积着薄尘。

facts.anchor: The community hall at Man Mo temple was commissioned through the generous donations of the Chinese community, in particular Ng Choy and Yau Yuhuan.
facts.fact: 文武庙的社区会堂由华人社区慷慨捐款兴建，匾额特别点名两位捐资人：Ng Choy 与 Yau Yuhuan。

facts.anchor: Madam Yau and Barrister Ng had made an odd couple; a man of the law and a brothel madam would not normally be seen together at an official event.
facts.fact: 奠基礼上 Yau 夫人与 Ng 大律师同场，一个法律人、一个妓院老鸨，官方场合本不会同框；但两人钱来路不同，出钱建楼时一样慷慨。

facts.anchor: She and Jingling had squatted beside it, running their fingers over the ornate reliefs as Por Por had spoken to the Buddhist priest.
facts.fact: 当年她与 Jingling 蹲在樟木箱旁抚摸箱盖上的浮雕，Por Por 正在同那位来访的和尚说话。

facts.anchor: Kiamling had been delighted, of course, until Por Por clarified it was just a loan. They needed to copy the scrolls, word for word, drawing for drawing, before returning the originals
facts.fact: 卷轴只是借来的：必须逐字、逐图抄完，才能把原件还回上海的寺庙。

facts.anchor: She was looking for a beast made of shadow and fire that stalked the streets at night with red eyes. Should be easy enough.
facts.fact: 她翻卷轴是要找一头「影与火构成、夜里红着眼巡街」的兽，原以为该很好找。

facts.anchor: The tingou, or heavenly dog, that ate the sun and moon was also made of darkness, but there had been no eclipse on the night of the fire.
facts.fact: 天狗（tingou）吞日月，也属黑暗一类，但火灾当晚并无日月食，故被排除。

facts.anchor: The year beast that emerged at the start of the new year was known to attack and eat people, but that festival was months away.
facts.fact: 年初才出的年兽会攻击吃人，但新年还有数月之遥，对不上。

facts.anchor: It was unheard of for the nin sau to emerge at any other time of year.
facts.fact: 年兽（nin sau）在一年中别的时节出现，是前所未闻的事。

facts.anchor: None of it quite fitted. She kept going, the pile of scrolls mounting up by her side. In the back of her mind she already knew they would offer no aid.
facts.fact: 没有一条完全吻合；她仍一卷卷往下翻、身旁卷轴越堆越高，心里其实早知道这些抄本帮不上忙——当年苦抄，多半正是 Por Por 的用意。

facts.anchor: The British had sat in the chairs reserved for the ghosts at the festival. Your ghosts aren’t real, Governor Bowring had said.
facts.fact: 节庆上英国人坐了留给鬼魂的椅子，总督 Bowring 说「你们的鬼不是真的」；他们拒不让座，影兽随后才出现。
